messages:
laura: hey folks, anyone else have their balcony WFH turn into a tiny music venue? posted a pic: <https://img.example/hammo.jpg> neighbor set up a practice amp and every ~10 minutes my wifi just drops :grimacing:

mike: oh no :scream: try switching to 5GHz or move the router off the metal railing. sometimes that fixes it right away.

sasha: could be RF from the amp or just interference on 2.4GHz. quick checks: `ping 8.8.8.8 -c 30` and `iwlist wlan0 scan | grep -i signal` — see if spikes line up with the playing.

laura: running ping now... spikes to ~400ms exactly when they hit a power chord lol. iwlist shows 3 APs stacked on channel 6.

ben: yeah that’s classic overlapping channels. force channel 1 or 11 on the AP, or enable band-steering to push everything to 5GHz. cheap mesh can also smooth it out.

mike: or move the modem/router inside and run a long USB-C ethernet adapter to the hammock spot. less sexy but works.

laura: I have a 5m USB-C to ethernet, but tempted to string it across the railing like a pirate. is that too much? :rofl:

sasha: do it. I once zip-tied a flat cable under my window trim, nobody noticed. also `nmcli radio wifi off && nmcli radio wifi on` is a quick soft reset while you tinker.

ops-bot: reminder: please check building rules before running external cables. some landlords are not fans :wave: (automated note)

laura: landlord would make me take it down but temporary solution worked — ran a 10m flat ethernet through the window gap and tucked it under the curtain. no more drops :partying_face: pic: <https://img.example/rig_after.jpg>

ben: legendary. what were the numbers before/after (for the crowd)?

laura: before: 18 Mbps down / 2 Mbps up, jitter spikes to 300-400ms when they played. after: 210 Mbps down / 45 Mbps up, stable <20ms. holy moly.

mike: heroic engineering. now hide the cable with a fake fern and claim it’s art.

sasha: also, if you talk to your neighbor, they might stagger practice times — or at least know the weirdly threatening stare of a wifi-slayer.

laura: gonna ask nicely tomorrow. thanks for the tips, team. saved my afternoon standup. will post a cozy before/after collage later for the random channel archive :camera_with_flash:

ben: waiting for the collage. extra karma if you include a dramatic amp closeup.

mike: coat-hanger antenna next week? :wink:
